value:
The Ochre Hand has offered silver for the return of its captives. The Stonecutter Raiders, who took them, are presumably already counting it. I suspect paying pirates to give back what they stole is not how most wars are meant to be won.

The Weir Federation still holds seven settlements, more than its two neighbours combined. The Ochre Hand has three and the Stonecutter Raiders four, and both prefer to spend their energy on each other. One assumes the Weir Federation finds this arrangement restful. It is day 205 of Jugust 5503. As far as I can tell, nobody near Wyrmfold has yet tried peace.

## Your briefing
Date: day 205 (Jugust 5503).
The colony you report near: Wyrmfold. You do not know what happens inside it unless listed below.

Factions:
- The Ochre Hand (Tribe): 3 settlements, at war with Stonecutter Raiders
- Stonecutter Raiders (Pirates): 4 settlements
- The Weir Federation (Outlanders): 7 settlements

Heard since your last bulletin (lead with these):
- The Ochre Hand offered silver for the return of its captives

Your earlier bulletins already covered (old news, background only):
- Stonecutter Raiders took captives from an Ochre Hand camp
- The Weir Federation raised a bounty on Stonecutter leaders
- Stonecutter Raiders are holding captives from the Ochre Hand

## Your earlier bulletins
Earlier bulletin:
The Ochre Hand and the Stonecutter Raiders are at war again, if they ever stopped. Word is that an Ochre Hand camp lost three of its people to a night raid.

Latest bulletin:
The Weir Federation has put a bounty on Stonecutter leaders. The sum is generous, the leaders are well armed, and I expect the bounty will go unclaimed for some time.

Write the bulletin now.

attempts.text:
The Ochre Hand has offered silver for the return of its captives. The Stonecutter Raiders, you may recall, took them from an Ochre Hand camp. Paying pirates for what pirates stole is an old arrangement, and I suspect the Raiders consider it a sound business model. One assumes the Hand would prefer to pay in something sharper.

Otherwise, Jugust is quiet on the rim. The Weir Federation still counts seven settlements, as many as both warring parties combined. Presumably that is why it posts bounties rather than fighting. The Stonecutters hold four settlements to the Hand's three, so the arithmetic favours the pirates, as it so often does.
